parameters.help_en: The product and detail information for the usage data, which is typically the ProductCode. Different services support multiple metering models

parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en:
The data timestamp type of the metering data. Refer to the specific service documentation for details. Valid values:
Raw: hourly
Hour: hourly
Day: daily
Month: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
计量数据时间类型，参考具体产品文档描述选用。
Raw：小时。
Hour：小时。
Day：天。
Month：月

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the request.

The date format must comply with the ISO 8601 standard and use UTC time. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
请求的开始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准标示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式：yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the request.

The date format must comply with the ISO 8601 standard and use UTC time. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
请求的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准标示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式：yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The marker that specifies the starting point for returning results in alphabetical order after the NextToken. By default, results are returned from the beginning

parameters.help_en: The number of rows per page for paging in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 100
